SwitchPreference.android:title: Enable Securize
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Disabling may fix play services on uncertified devices

SwitchPreference.android:title: Treat virtual sensors as real
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Treat all virtual fingerprint sensors as real\nWarning: This can cause bootloops - use with extreme care\nRequires a reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Activity Anim Perf Override
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Forces the use of performance optimization in activity animations\nRequires reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: LMK Tweaks
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Apply tweaks to Low Memory Killer to improve stability and prevent aggressive shutdowns\nRequires reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Bluetooth fix
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Maybe this will fix your Bluetooth problem.\nRequires reboot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Unisoc black screen workaround
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Enables a workaround for black screen issues on some Unisoc devices. May affect color-based display features. Requires framework support. Applies instantly

SwitchPreference.android:title: Scroll Boost
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Improves scrolling smoothness by applying a temporary performance boost during scroll gestures. On heavier apps, it may use a more aggressive performance profile depending on vendor support. On low-RAM devices, this may increase memory pressure and reduce smoothness in some situations.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Universal legacy-kernel BPF fallback
SwitchPreference.android:summary: ON (true): uses the real kernel version and enables the safer traffic-statistics fallback. Recommended for older kernels and may keep the traffic indicator working. OFF (false): reports kernel 5.10.239 to enable the full BPF compatibility path and may fix firewall-bypass connectivity. Disabling the fallback can break the traffic indicator or cause a black screen, OEM screen, Wi-Fi boot failure, or bootloader issue on unsupported devices. Reboot required. This patch is universal for supported SoC vendors. The MTK BPF Patcher is optional and only applies to supported MediaTek kernels.

SwitchPreference.android:title: A2dp Identity address
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Some devices connect over Bluetooth correctly, but fail to expose the A2DP\noutput route to AudioPolicyManager, causing media audio to continue playing\nthrough the phone speaker.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Safe Media Volume Bypas
SwitchPreference.android:summary: disable framework safe media volume checks, warnings, and volume clamping.

Preference.android:title: ⚠️ Important: Use only ONE codec mode at a time
Preference.android:summary: Enable only ONE option below. After changing, you MUST reboot before trying another mode. Using multiple modes simultaneously will cause conflicts and may break video recording or screen recording. Start with 'Prefer hardware codecs' (default) and only change if you have issues.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Prefer hardware codecs (Recommended)
SwitchPreference.android:summary:
✅ BEST FOR PERFORMANCE - Default mode for most devices

Uses vendor hardware codecs for video recording and playback:
• Lowest CPU usage and best battery life
• Fastest encoding/decoding speed
• Hardware-accelerated by SoC DSP
• Default mode - try this first

⚠️ Enable ONLY this option, then reboot
❌ Disable all other codec modes

Performance: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Battery: Excellent | CPU: Low

SwitchPreference.android:title: Force software codecs
SwitchPreference.android:summary:
⚠️ USE ONLY IF HW CODECS FAIL - Higher CPU usage

Uses software/OMX codecs instead of hardware:
• Higher CPU usage and battery drain
• Slower encoding but more compatible
• Use c2.android.* software codecs
• Fallback for buggy hardware codecs

⚠️ Steps:
1. Disable 'Prefer hardware codecs'
2. Enable this option
3. REBOOT immediately
4. Test video recording

Enable ONLY if:
• Video recording crashes or hangs
• Corrupted video files
• Audio/video sync issues

Performance: ⭐⭐⭐ | Battery: Fair | CPU: High

SwitchPreference.android:title: Fix screen recorder
SwitchPreference.android:summary:
⚠️ FOR SCREEN RECORDING ISSUES ONLY

Compatibility mode for screen recording:
• Prioritizes software codecs for input surface
• Balanced C2 + OMX configuration
• Fixes black screen or crashes
• Intermediate OMX rank (256)

⚠️ Steps:
1. Disable all other codec modes
2. Enable this option
3. REBOOT immediately
4. Test screen recording

Enable if:
• Screen recorder shows black screen
• Screen recorder crashes on start
• Recording stops unexpectedly

Performance: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Battery: Good | CPU: Medium

SwitchPreference.android:title: Max compatibility mode
SwitchPreference.android:summary:
⚠️ BALANCED MODE - For older or problematic devices

Maximum codec compatibility:
• C2 + OMX work together
• OMX preferred but C2 available
• Good for Android 10 or older
• Fallback for buggy C2

⚠️ Steps:
1. Disable all other codec modes
2. Enable this option
3. REBOOT immediately
4. Test recording

Enable if:
• Video recording fails with other modes
• Screen recorder unstable
• Old device with codec issues
• Android 10 or older

Performance: ⭐⭐⭐ | Battery: Fair | CPU: Medium-High

SwitchPreference.android:title: Legacy mode (Android 9 or less)
SwitchPreference.android:summary:
⚠️ FOR ANDROID 9 OR BOOTLOOPS ONLY - Last resort

Disables Codec2 completely:
• Only OMX codecs available
• Slowest mode, highest CPU usage
• For Android 9 or older devices
• Use if C2 causes bootloop/crash

⚠️ Steps:
1. Disable all other codec modes
2. Enable this option
3. REBOOT immediately
4. Test device stability

Enable ONLY if:
• Android 9 or older
• C2 causes bootloop
• System crashes with C2
• All other modes fail

WARNING: Avoid unless necessary!
Performance: ⭐⭐ | Battery: Poor | CPU: High

SwitchPreference.android:title: Max performance mode
SwitchPreference.android:summary:
⚠️ MAXIMUM PERFORMANCE - For Android 11+ with stable C2

Prioritizes C2 hardware codecs above all:
• C2 hardware codecs always first
• OMX as last resort only (rank 1024)
• Maximum encoding speed
• Best battery efficiency
• Lowest CPU usage

⚠️ Steps:
1. Disable all other codec modes
2. Enable this option
3. REBOOT immediately
4. Test recording

Enable ONLY if:
• Android 11 or newer
• C2 implementation is stable
• You want maximum performance
• Video recording works perfectly

WARNING: May cause compatibility issues on older devices!
Performance: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Battery: Best | CPU: Lowest
